detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #9 Kernel Network Adaptation The packets on the wire begin with decisions inside the stack. Before network release, PH4NTXM configures bounded TCP/IP values for the selected Linux or Windows profile: ports, retries, timers, socket buffers, congestion control, MTU probing, and other supported settings. Required values are read back, and failed required settings prevent successful completion. Network preparation also requests route and neighbor cleanup and disables saving TCP metrics on a best-effort basis. These stages prepare the local stack. The Packet Transformation Engine handles the separate packet-level changes. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
